tests.prompt: Call InitDungeon on a region with a nil/empty ObstacleSpec list (every pre-#819 caller). Verify SpaceData.Obstacles is empty -- fully backward compatible, opt-in mechanism.
Give one region an ObstacleSpec with Count=3. Verify exactly 3 ObstacleData entries are placed, each carrying the spec's Ref/BlocksMovement/BlocksLoS verbatim.
Give one region two distinct ObstacleSpecs. Verify all instances place without error and no two instances share a hex.
Build the same InitDungeon call twice with the same seed. Verify every obstacle ID is non-empty, unique within the dungeon, and the ID SET is identical across both builds.
Build the same InitDungeon call (with ObstacleSpecs) twice with the same seed. Verify SpaceData.Obstacles is byte-for-byte identical.
With a candidate pool much larger than the requested obstacle count, build with several different seed pairs. Verify at least one pair produces different obstacle positions.
Overload a boss region with a large obstacle count (PatternRandom walls present). Verify no placed obstacle sits on the shared doorRow (the required-path / primary-combat-axis row).
Heavily obstacle-load an entrance/corridor/boss dungeon. Open both connector doors. Verify the entrance still reaches the boss region via a walkable path.

Request 1000 instances of an obstacle spec in a 4x4 region (at most ~12 safe candidate cells). Verify InitDungeon succeeds (no error) and places fewer than 1000 -- decoration must never fail structural generation.

Place obstacles with mixed BlocksMovement/BlocksLoS, ToData, then LoadFromData into a fresh Encounter. Verify Obstacles round-trip byte-for-byte and the reloaded room's actual movement-blocking at each obstacle's position matches its declared BlocksMovement.

Build CryptDungeonParams. Verify entrance carries obelisk+pillar (never coffin/altar/statue), corridor carries only a single sparse pillar (never the other 4 refs), and boss carries coffin+altar+2 flanking statues (never obelisk).
Verify every approved crypt obstacle ref matches the plain opaque 'dnd5e:obstacles:<kind>' shape -- no model filename or Synty-specific path.
InitDungeon a real crypt via CryptDungeonParams. Verify it succeeds and every placed obstacle's ref is within the 5 approved crypt refs.
InitDungeon a real crypt via CryptDungeonParams, open both connector doors. Verify the entrance still reaches the boss region.
Build the same CryptDungeonParams seed twice. Verify walls AND obstacles are identical across both builds.
